definitions.explanation: A piece of land surrounded by water. Japan itself is an island nation (島国) composed of many islands.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{島国|しまぐに}→島国：12339_shimaguni⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧{島|しま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}きたい→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: I want to go to that island.

examples.japanese: ⟦{沖縄|おきなわ}→沖縄：11009_okinawa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{島|しま}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are many islands in Okinawa.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{島|しま}⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{泳|およ}ぎに→泳ぐ：00545_oyogu⟧⟦{行|い}きました→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to an island to swim in the summer.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{島|しま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{住|す}んでいない→住む：00673_sumu⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: No one lives on this island, so it's very quiet and the sea is beautiful.

notes:
{島|しま} means island. ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧ is an ⟦{島国|しまぐに}→島国：12339_shimaguni⟧ (island nation) with over 6,800 islands.

MAJOR ISLANDS:
- ⟦{本州|ほんしゅう}→本州：18528_honshuu⟧: Honshu (main island)
- ⟦{北海道|ほっかいどう}→北海道：11010_hokkaidou⟧: Hokkaido
- ⟦{九州|きゅうしゅう}→九州：15647_kyuushuu⟧: Kyushu
- ⟦{四国|しこく}→四国：21447_shikoku⟧: Shikoku

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {島|しま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{渡|わた}る→渡る：02441_wataru⟧: to cross to an island
- ⟦{離|はな}れ{島|じま}→離れ島：noentry⟧: remote island
- ⟦{無人|むじん}{島|とう}→無人島：16950_mujintou⟧: uninhabited island

READINGS IN COMPOUNDS:
- しま: standalone or in native compounds (⟦{島国|しまぐに}→島国：12339_shimaguni⟧)
- じま: after other words (rendaku): ⟦{離|はな}れ{島|じま}→離れ島：noentry⟧
- とう: in Sino-Japanese compounds (⟦{無人|むじん}{島|とう}→無人島：16950_mujintou⟧)

The word appears in many place names: ⟦{広島|ひろしま}→広島：28985_hiroshima⟧, ⟦{鹿児島|かごしま}→鹿児島：noentry⟧, ⟦{宮島|みやじま}→宮島：noentry⟧.
